application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions:
Consent is refused for the following works: T1, T37 -T41, T46, T48, T50, T61, T64 - T77, T79, T80, T91 (Horse Chestnut), T2 - T4, T10, T14, T18 - T21, T24 (Hornbeam), T5 - T8, T25 - T27 (Sorbus), T11, T42, T62, T82, T84, T85, T86 (Oak), T16, T23, T47, T57, T78, T83 (Sycamore), T53 (Poplar), T54, T58 (False Acacia), T81 (Norway Maple), T89, T90 (Lime), G1 (Norway Maple x 3) and G2 (Horse Chestnut) - reduce canopy by 1 - 1.5m to nearest suitable growth point; and T9, T12, T13 (Cherry), T28, T30, T31, T35 (Apple) and T32 - T34 (Pear).

The proposed crown reductions lack any arboricultural justification, represent a blanket reduction across numerous trees without individual assessment, and would cause unnecessary stress, loss of canopy structure and reduced photosynthetic capacity, which would harm the health and amenity value of the protected trees.
